Control an active media player with optional notification access.

To find and control compatible players, Luma uses Android notification access. Android grants this service access to all notifications, not only music. Luma queries active media sessions and does not read, store, or upload notification contents. You can revoke access in Android settings at any time.

1. Enable optional notification access below.
2. Return Home, open the widget picker, and add Luma Glass Music.
3. Start playback in a compatible player.

The widget displays available track information and only the controls supported by that player. With no active session it shows a message instead. This screen configures access; playback controls live on the home widget.
